name: C7-B1 only: actual source interventions and passive causal equivalence
source_intervention: active do(Y_t=I_t) for entire0..25; I zero outside10..14; overwrites both endogenous source generators; not editing X
observation: dX=(1.5-.15X-U)dt+sigma*dW, sensor V_U=U+eta; source actuator gain assumed calibrated to1; unknown individual tau marginalized

input_design.I0: no do intervention; endogenous sources, X/U exactly same across labels
input_design.I1: unit step held10..14 then released/clamped0; not a permanent step
input_design.I3: 16 blocks of.25, exactly8 on at sqrt(2), first on and7 remaining selected randomly independent of label

energy: all active total int I^2dt=4, amplitude<=sqrt(8); report consumed energy at decision because early energy is not matched
training: new healthy-X AR and healthy sensor variance only; hypotheses predeclared, no true labels/tau/hidden source to inference
decision: prefix Gaussian likelihood and equal model priors, uniform log-grid tau prior for H1; posterior>=.95 same class2 updates then irrevocable first commit; no truth-driven retry
primary: X-only correct first-commit coverage by14, each active input vs paired passive I0;3 Bonferroni contrasts98.3333% paired stratified-cluster bootstrap,5pp reference and both cohorts positive
uncertainty: hard argmax accuracy separate from committed accuracy, wrong-first, refusal, delay and all-event coverage; do not call identity confidence a failure alarm
null_controls: blank do(Y=0) has identical candidate predictions and should give no identity commitment; separate registered-input nominal goodness-of-fit monitor evaluates whole-trajectory false anomaly rate
nominal_monitor: minimum cumulative whitened residual sum over H1 tau grid and H2 direct, standardized by observation count; separately calibrated no-fault mixture of input types and both mechanisms; no true label passed to monitor

calibration.threshold: binomial order-statistic tolerance, simultaneous95% over6 noise/observation cells

interpretation: active-model identity is not a causal-failure alarm; nominal-monitor recall not tested; true system fixed during each trial; all conclusions conditional on actuator modularity and calibrated units
equivalence_control: eliminating U in H1 gives same physical model for every source command; interventions cannot distinguish that alternate representation
